data.description:
## Context / Problem

A harness nobody is required to use changes nothing. Contributors editing a criterion prompt, a Pass-2 question, or a Pass-3 threshold need to know which tier applies, what report to attach to the Gerrit change, how to read "indistinguishable from noise", and how the budget is allocated per proposal. The decision also has to be reconciled with the record: ADR 0054 (field corpus is the instrument; new labelled sets rejected on cost) and epic 6982's "no live A/B" directive.

## Approach

- Write an ADR (`docs/adr/`) recording: the three tiers and what each measures; the model-parity rule (production model per pass, Bedrock only, no substitution); the budget ledger and cap; the noise-band acceptance rule (a change is improving/regressing only outside the band from identical-material flips and the Tier-1 reproduction run); why sidecar replay supersedes recorded-response mocking (`jira-reb-529`); how this extends rather than contradicts ADR 0054.
- Add a section to `docs/plan-review-gate.md` (and a pointer in `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md`) with a tier-selection table: Pass-3 code/threshold/routing change → Tier 0 required, always; Pass-2 question/prompt change → Tier 1 on N≥40 plus Tier 0; Pass-1 criterion prompt → Tier 2 single-criterion (N=20) plus downstream; finder system prompt or chunking → Tier 2 full mode. The report file path is named in the commit message under a `plan-review-eval:` trailer (advisory; no CI enforcement, to stay portable).
- Publish the per-proposal cost table from the commissioning runs so future spend is planned.

## Scope

- `docs/adr/00NN-plan-review-replay-harness.md` (new)
- `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md`, `docs/README.md` (edits)

## Testing

Docs-only; `make lint` link/format checks. No new testable behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The ADR exists, is listed in the ADR index, and cites ADR 0054 and epic 6982; checked by reading the index.
- [ ] `docs/plan-review-gate.md` contains the tier-selection table and the noise-band rule and links the ADR; checked by reading the doc.
- [ ] The per-proposal cost table matches the ledger's commissioning rows; checked by comparing the two.
data.title: Change protocol: ADR + contributor guide for measuring plan-review proposals (tier selection, required report, noise-band rule)
